record_type_quote: Thus, our principal research goal is to conduct a direct replication of the original UA findings from Hsee et al., (2013) as well as extend these findings to additional charitable domains.

targets.authors: Hsee, C. K., Zhang, J., Lu, Z. Y., & Xu, F.
targets.title: Unit asking: A method to boost donation and beyond.
targets.evidence_quote: The participants faced with the scenario concerning children were asked to imagine that Christmas is around the corner and were introduced to a kindergarten asking for donations to buy presents for 20 children from low income families. This condition identical to study 1 in Hsee et al. (2013).
targets.outcome_quote: First, our results replicate Hsee et al. (2013), demonstrating that UA effectively increases donations to children in that specific charity scenario.

reasoning: Completed direct replication of Hsee et al. Study 1 plus new-domain extensions. Authors explicitly confirm the original result despite a smaller effect. Simmons supplied materials and is discussed as an earlier replication, not the finding being re-tested.
